note: Every test a run may skip, and why. scope "always": the test can't run on that platform, so the skip is expected everywhere. scope "ci": CI lacks the models or fixtures, so the skip is expected there, but a qualification run must run the test and fails if it skips. scripts/check-test-skips.mjs reads this file; a skip not listed here, or not allowed for the run's platform and mode, is reported, and fails a qualification run.

skips.id: RoachVoice hydration fails clearly before any download when Core ML tooling is unavailable
skips.why: It covers a machine without Core ML tooling. Every Mac has that tooling, so the test skips itself on macOS.
skips.disposition: Runs on Linux, where it passes.
